g.text: GDHUB-107 — choosing an expert leads to a waitlist, never to payment

text.tspan: Server guard: PUT draft with curatorKind Human → 400 expertClosed
POST pay with a Human draft → 400 expertClosed
(behind a config flag EXPERT_CHECKPOINT_OPEN = false; the code paths stay)
expert checkpoints already paid or running are untouched
the draft opens with curatorKind AI
AI card selected: 'Run to the next checkpoint with AI' · 20 USD
12.4a: 'Run with an expert is coming soon'
experts table and first-call picker hidden
Next disabled; the draft stays AI on the server

g.text: Join the waitlist · Choose the AI curator
12.4b: 'You're on the waitlist' · Choose the AI curator
Choose the AI curator → AI card selected again

text.tspan: email = the account's email; createdAt kept on a repeat
count, email, createdAt desc; search by email

g.text: even if the UI is bypassed
